# Lab6

<!-- badges: start -->

<!-- badges: end -->

This package implements three different algorithms to the [napsack
problem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knapsack_problem).

## Installation

You can install the development version of Lab6 from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Jonatanprepuk/Lab6")
```

## Example

### Create data

``` r
library(Lab6)

suppressWarnings(RNGversion(min(as.character(getRversion()), "3.5.3")))
set.seed(42, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
n <- 1000000
knapsack_objects <- data.frame(
  w = sample(1:4000, size = n, replace = TRUE),
  v = runif(n = n, 0, 10000)
)
```

### Brute force

``` r
brute_force_knapsack(knapsack_objects[1:16, ], W = 3500)
#> $value
#> [1] 18091.78
#> 
#> $elements
#> [1]  3  8 14
```

### Dynamic

``` r
knapsack_dynamic(knapsack_objects[1:500, ], W = 5000)
#> $value
#> [1] 220078.3
#> 
#> $elements
#>  [1]  35  37  55  71  77  80  92 110 117 195 196 214 229 234 237 255 282 288 290
#> [20] 332 345 346 374 390 401 406 434 436 450 462 472 500
```
